input: Build a personal knowledge management system in Obsidian

gold.taskTitle: Build a Personal Knowledge System in Obsidian
gold.taskDescription: Set up a fully functional personal knowledge management system inside Obsidian tailored to the user's workflow and note-taking needs.

questions.title: What types of knowledge do you primarily want to capture?
questions.description: For example: book notes, research, meeting notes, ideas, journal entries, project documentation, or a mix.

questions.title: Do you have an existing note-taking system you are migrating from?
questions.description: For example: Notion, Roam Research, Evernote, plain folders, paper notebooks, or starting from scratch.

questions.title: What is your primary use case for this system?
questions.description: For example: personal learning, academic research, professional work, creative writing, or a combination.

questions.title: Which organizational structure resonates most with you?
questions.description: For example: folders and subfolders, the PARA method, Zettelkasten linking, Maps of Content, or a flat structure.

questions.title: How comfortable are you with Obsidian plugins and customization?
questions.description: For example: complete beginner, some experience with core plugins, or comfortable installing and configuring community plugins.

questions.title: What does success look like for this system in 3 months?
questions.description: For example: 100 linked notes, a daily review habit, a working project tracker, or being able to resurface old ideas quickly.

questions.title: How much time can you dedicate to building this each week?
questions.description: For example: 30 minutes on weekends, one hour per weekday, or a focused multi-day setup sprint.
